test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What is the venue for 4th Edition of Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __Haryana.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The 4th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games:

__
 
• It was held in Haryana.__
 
• The Games will be held in Panchkula.
 
• The Haryana government has decided to organize the Khelo India Youth Games in February 2022, in view of the possible third wave of the Covid-19 pandemic.
 
• Gatka, Kalaripayattu, Thang-Ta, and Mallakhamba, four indigenous games were added in December 2020.
 
• Haryana came second in both Khelo India Youth Games 2019 and 2020 editions (200 medals in 2020 and 159 medals in 2019).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Khelo India Youth Games are an annual multidisciplinary grassroots game organised at a national level in India in January or February.
 
• Previously known as Khelo India School Games (KISG).
 
• It is held for two groups of students: under-17-year-olds in high school and under-21-year-olds in college.
 
• Every year, the top 1,000 children will be awarded a 5-lakh annual scholarship for the next eight years in order to prepare them for international sporting events.
 
• The first edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in Delhi in 2018.
 
• The second edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in Pune in 2019.
 
• The third edition of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in Guwahati in 2020.
